sentences.en: I am a commissioner of Habin Geratology Specialty Council, syndic of Heilongjiang living Habit Diseases Research Center, member of Medical Treatment Accident Technical Authentication Experts Society .

sentences.en: Objectie To discuss the characteristics and management countermeasure of nursing work in the department of geratology in the new period.

sentences.en: Methods The author analyzed the characteristics of nursing work in the department of geratology and put forward the management countermeasures for the nurses and patients.

sentences.en: Therefore, the prolong of human average life makes it more obvious that AD do more harm to human health. It has been one of the most serious problems of geratology.
sentences.vi: Do đó, việc kéo dài tuổi thọ trung bình của con người cho thấy rõ ràng rằng AD gây hại nhiều hơn cho sức khỏe con người. Đây là một trong những vấn đề nghiêm trọng nhất của địa chất.
